propositions: Implement an explicit opt-in read-only tracker-footprint command that measures mounted tracker and fresh-clone footprint separately without running from ticket writes or gates

Report layered measurements including packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, Git-directory bytes, and whole-clone totals with structured unavailable values for unsupported allocation accounting
Distinguish shared object stores from standalone clone measurements and measure fresh-clone on temporary unfiltered single-branch clones without affecting source or remote state
Output measurement reports with measured ref/tip and definitions in both text and JSON formats validated against tracker_footprint.schema.json schema
Reject any hard budget threshold, shrink-only ratchet, scheduled trigger, or CI/Gerrit gate as out of scope to avoid workflow fragility
